purpose: Teach: 車輪/離陸/発車/発せ/呼び出さ/乗り込み/買い求め/現況

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、台車の車輪交換を毎月点検しろ
lines.en: We need to inspect the cart wheel replacements every month without fail.
lines.style: Measured, authoritative opening. Clear enunciation on the directive. Steady pace, no softening. The tone of someone used to being listened to.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。物流倉庫の航空便、つまり離陸時刻を確認します
lines.en: Understood. I'll confirm the departure times for all air shipments from the logistics warehouse.
lines.style: Attentive, taking mental note. Slight forward lean in the posture. Respectful but not servile — the cadence of someone making a commitment.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、配送車の発車時刻を厳守しろ
lines.en: And make sure delivery vehicle departure times are strictly adhered to — no exceptions.
lines.style: Firm, almost clipped on 'strictly.' Lean forward slightly for emphasis. This is non-negotiable. The weight of an executive who expects compliance.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。全社員にメッセージを発せられる体制を整えます
lines.en: Understood. I'll set up a system where we can reach all staff instantly whenever we need to.
lines.style: Assured, already moving mentally to execution. Slight quickening in pace as he outlines the plan. Confident but respectful in tone.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社員が呼び出される際の手順を文書化しろ
lines.en: Then document the exact procedure for when staff are called in. Make it formal.
lines.style: Direct, almost matter-of-fact. Slight pause before 'formal' — letting the word land. This is administrative rigor, not suggestion.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新人が現場へ乗り込みやすい体制にします
lines.en: Understood. I'll restructure the process so new hires can get to the site quickly and without confusion.
lines.style: Brisk, solution-oriented. Speaking slightly faster now — energy building with the plan. Tone lifts slightly at the end, showing readiness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社員が必要な備品を買い求められる経費枠を増やせ
lines.en: Increase the equipment budget available to staff. They need proper resources to do the work.
lines.style: Quiet conviction underneath. Not loud, but it carries weight. Slight emphasis on 'resources' — this is about enabling people, not just directives.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。現況報告を毎週金曜にまとめます
lines.en: Understood. I'll compile a status report every Friday and keep you updated.
lines.style: Calm close. Breathing settles. Tone indicates completion of task list — professional, steady. A slight nod in the voice.
